drupal_integration.summary: The Drupal integration has strong architectural bones — correct behavior patterns, comprehensive documentation, SSR-safe token adoption, functional SDC coverage — but is undermined by four pre-ship critical defects that would cause fatal errors or broken npm publishes on day one. The library name mismatch in helixui.module is a Drupal fatal error on every page load. CDN artifacts have never been built. The drupal-starter workspace:^ peer dependency breaks npm consumers entirely. hx-button SDC enum values do not match the component source. These are not polish issues — they are blockers that make the integration non-functional as shipped.

monorepo_health.summary: The monorepo tooling shows genuine sophistication — the Vite entry point discovery, adopted stylesheets default, preflight script architecture, and CEM validation are production-grade. However, two critical defects prevent a clean release: a worktree-specific path is committed to the root package.json (will break every CI run and collaborator clone), and the drupal-behaviors package is an unbuilt, untyped package with source files as its published entry point. The Turborepo pipeline has additional high-severity caching defects (test coverage outputs not captured, generate outputs path incorrect, react prebuild cold-start race). Root package name is a stale placeholder. These are fixable in days but must be fixed before 3.0.0.

code_quality.summary: The chief-code-reviewer's assessment reveals systemic copy-paste contamination across the codebase. The most severe finding is a pattern problem: at least three components (hx-text-input, hx-select, hx-checkbox) register incorrect HTMLElementEventMap types — each using a copy-pasted union type that includes event shapes they never emit. This is not three bugs; it is one systemic failure in the event typing workflow. Two components (hx-tooltip, hx-breadcrumb) directly mutate consumer light DOM, violating a foundational web components contract. hx-dialog has a dual state management race condition in the library's most critical interactive component. hx-date-picker has minified CSS checked in as source. Internal APIs (resetIdCounter, HelixAuditController) are exported publicly. The hx-dialog modal default inverts HTML boolean attribute semantics. Collectively, these represent unacceptable quality for a 3.0.0 release of infrastructure-grade software.

blockers.title: helixui.module library name mismatch causes Drupal fatal error
blockers.detail: attach_library('helixui/hx-core') does not match the key 'helixui/core' defined in helixui.libraries.yml — Drupal fatal error on every page load.

blockers.title: CDN build artifacts do not exist — CDN integration path is non-functional
blockers.detail: The build:cdn script exists but has never been run. dist/cdn/ is empty. The CDN path documented in INTEGRATION.md cannot ship.

blockers.title: SDC component.yml variant enums do not match component source — silent failures in production
blockers.detail: hx-button.component.yml lists 'success' and 'link' as valid variants; the component defines primary|secondary|tertiary|danger|ghost|outline. CDN INTEGRATION.md also uses 'destructive' which is not a valid value.

blockers.title: drupal-starter peerDependency uses workspace:^ protocol — breaks npm consumers
blockers.detail: workspace:^ is only valid inside the monorepo. Drupal teams installing @helixui/drupal-starter from npm will receive a broken package that fails peer dependency resolution.

blockers.title: Worktree-specific path committed to root package.json — breaks CI and all collaborator machines
blockers.detail: The 'customElements' field points to '.worktrees/feature-healthba-hx-carousel-document-25/...' which does not exist outside the original developer's machine.

blockers.title: drupal-behaviors package is unbuilt and untyped — not publishable
blockers.detail: Uses 'main': 'src/index.js' with no exports map, no types field, and no build script. TypeScript consumers receive no types. Source files are the published entry point.

blockers.title: Systemic HTMLElementEventMap copy-paste contamination across hx-text-input, hx-select, hx-checkbox
blockers.detail: All three components register hx-change with a union type that includes event shapes they never emit. hx-text-input and hx-select include a 'checked' field they do not dispatch; hx-checkbox includes a 'value only' branch that is incorrect for its always-checked shape. This is a systemic pattern failure in the event typing workflow.

blockers.title: hx-tooltip mutates consumer light DOM — violates web component encapsulation contract
blockers.detail: _lightDomDescription is appended as a child of 'this' via this.appendChild(), corrupting consumer DOM structure and breaking CSS child selectors and querySelector on the parent element.

blockers.title: hx-dialog dual state management race condition and inverted boolean default
blockers.detail: Component 'open' property and native dialog.showModal() create dual state management with a synchronization race during rapid open/close cycles. Separately, modal defaults to true, inverting HTML boolean attribute semantics and making the attribute non-toggleable via HTML.

blockers.title: hx-date-picker.styles.ts is minified CSS checked in as source — unmaintainable and contains hardcoded colors
blockers.detail: The entire stylesheet is one continuous minified line. Contains hardcoded rgba() color values not behind design tokens. Minification belongs in the build pipeline, not source.

blockers.title: No SRI hash support for CDN loading strategy — fails enterprise healthcare security audits
blockers.detail: HIPAA-compliant enterprise clients require Subresource Integrity hashes on all third-party CDN assets. None are generated or documented.

blockers.title: hx-phi-field PHI data attribute is readable pre-JS — HIPAA compliance concern
blockers.detail: Raw PHI value passed via the 'data' attribute is present in the DOM as a plain attribute value readable by automated tools until JavaScript loads and applies masking via Shadow DOM.

blockers.title: resetIdCounter and HelixAuditController exported publicly — API surface pollution
blockers.detail: resetIdCounter breaks ARIA associations in live components if called at runtime. HelixAuditController is an internal observability tool. Both are exposed as first-class public API in index.ts.

blockers.title: hx-breadcrumb injects dynamic elements into consumer light DOM via document.createElement
blockers.detail: _applyCollapse() creates an hx-breadcrumb-item and injects it into consumer light DOM via firstItem.after(). Violates encapsulation, causes double-rendering, breaks SSR.

blockers.title: hx-tabs updated() lifecycle check for @state() field is permanently unreachable dead code
blockers.detail: Lit's PropertyValues<this> does not surface @state() fields — only @property() declarations. The .has('_activePanel') check will never be true, making _updateTabsAndPanels() unreachable from the updated() lifecycle path.

top_findings: Drupal fatal error on every page load due to library key mismatch in helixui.module (G3-B01) — one-line fix, maximum-impact blocker
CDN build artifacts have never been built — the entire CDN integration path is non-functional for 3.0.0 (G3-B02)
Systemic HTMLElementEventMap copy-paste contamination across at least three components introduces incorrect global type information visible to all TypeScript consumers (G3-B07)
hx-tooltip and hx-breadcrumb both mutate consumer light DOM directly, violating the foundational web components encapsulation contract (G3-B08, G3-B14)
hx-dialog has a dual state management race condition in the library's most critical interactive component, with an additional boolean default that inverts HTML semantics (G3-B09)
hx-date-picker.styles.ts is minified CSS checked in as source — impossible to review, diff, or maintain, and contains hardcoded colors that break theming (G3-B10)
drupal-behaviors package is unbuilt and untyped with source files as its published entry point — not publishable in current state (G3-B06)
hx-phi-field exposes raw PHI values as DOM attributes before JavaScript loads — HIPAA compliance concern for a healthcare-first library (G3-B12)
resetIdCounter and HelixAuditController are exported as public API — the former breaks ARIA associations in live components if misused (G3-B13)
Worktree-specific absolute path committed to root package.json breaks every CI run and collaborator machine (G3-B05)

scoring_rationale.drupal_integration: Score 4.5/10. Architecture is sound: behavior patterns, libraries.yml structure, documentation coverage, SSR safety, and SDC breadth are all strong. However, four critical defects make the integration non-functional as shipped: fatal Drupal error from library name mismatch, CDN artifacts that do not exist, workspace:^ protocol that breaks npm consumers, and SDC enum values that diverge from the component source. SRI and PHI field exposure are additional high-severity concerns specific to the healthcare enterprise context. Fundamentals require remediation before any client deployment.
scoring_rationale.monorepo_health: Score 5.5/10. The tooling foundation is sophisticated — Vite entry discovery, preflight scripting, CEM validation, and changeset configuration are production-grade. The worktree path committed to root package.json is the most egregious defect (how did this pass CI?). drupal-behaviors package is structurally unpublishable. Turborepo pipeline has meaningful caching defects that waste CI cycles and produce stale coverage reads. React wrapper prebuild race on cold clone is a poor developer experience. The gap between the tooling intent and the execution is significant.
scoring_rationale.code_quality: Score 4.0/10. The chief-code-reviewer found systemic patterns, not isolated bugs. The HTMLElementEventMap contamination across multiple components signals a copy-paste culture with no cross-component review checkpoint. The light DOM mutation violations in hx-tooltip and hx-breadcrumb are fundamental web components errors that experienced Lit developers should not ship. hx-dialog's dual state management is an architectural defect in the library's flagship interactive component. hx-date-picker's minified source is an operational red flag. The public API surface has internal tooling exports that will create semantic versioning obligations. The codebase has strong moments (HelixElement base class, adopted stylesheets pattern, CEM accuracy) but the review surfaces a pattern of 'finished but not done' across too many components for a 3.0.0 label.
scoring_rationale.overall: Weighted average of three equal dimensions: (4.5 + 5.5 + 4.0) / 3 = 4.67, rounded to 4.7. BLOCKED verdict is unambiguous. 11 critical findings and 15 helix_3_blocker items across integration correctness, monorepo packaging, and code quality. The most urgent fixes (library name mismatch, worktree path in package.json, HTMLElementEventMap types) could be completed in a single focused sprint. The structural issues (hx-dialog architecture, hx-tooltip light DOM, CDN pipeline) require more careful work. Estimated 4 weeks to clear all blockers assuming dedicated engineering capacity.
